brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single cell piece:0,0,0;full with solid cover on top (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and 6 solid end caps on all side faces (caps at 30,90,150,210,270,330) forming fully enclosed box; lockJoints applied, meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre installed in slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0, stem hex-port-louvre) – vents closed cell without letting rain in, allowing airflow for board

finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed box with top cover and all six side caps sealed, fitted with hex-port-louvre in one wall for ventilation. Checked clear.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.
